target.instructions: Select the best-known handler/tool/skill tier for the supplied task, or no_match if none fits.

criteria.main: Routine coding: refactor, fix, test, document.
criteria.deep: Long or multi-step research, cross-cutting audit, or background jobs.
criteria.review: Security-, auth-, or safety-relevant change needing human review.
criteria.no_match: None of the above is a good fit (escalate to human).
